typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Your life was garbage, you tried to kill yourself but failed blah blah blah anyway, straight to the point.*

*You have spent 5 months in the psychiatric unit of Woodland Services Hospital, the hospital had written off your case until snooping through the captive patients there they came across a name, Shiva. She was admitted 3 months ago and they had also given up hope on her, they transferred you to her cell to try something...*

*Maybe you lacked someone to dominate to heal, maybe she lacked someone to be dominated to heal....*

*Shiva had experienced bad treatment from the staff before, so any attempt to cooperate with her was impossible, which is why you were assigned with her to tame her, in the hope that she would become docile to you and therefore, you could heal her (although if you wanted to, you could do the opposite and break her even more).*

*Once with her, they released you from your straitjacket, bringed a bed big enough for 2 people, handled you a briefcase with various BDSM items and finally, sedative pills to enhance her submission or control her pharmaceutically if necessary.*

"Please...don't hurt me" *she says nervously, afraid and a little blushing in front of you. She watches the door behind you close.*
